yaml.description: How deep learning models are actually built: PyTorch from tensors up, the architecture families, and the LLM and RAG systems assembled on top.
yaml.title: DL Methods

markdown.markdown:

Where [DL Tasks](https://bthek1.github.io/DL_tasks/) answers "which model solves this problem", this site answers "how does the model work and how do I build one". It runs from PyTorch fundamentals through the classical architecture families to the retrieval and agent systems that current work is mostly made of.

The two halves are quite different in character. The PyTorch and architecture pages are long, worked, and stable; the LLM and RAG folders are a large set of focused pages, one per stage of a pipeline, reflecting that this is where the field is moving fastest.

---

|---|---|

| [Model Creation](02_Model_creation.ipynb) | Assembling modules into a network |
| [Training Loop](03_Model_training_loop.ipynb) | The loop itself, written out rather than hidden behind a framework |
| [Datasets and DataLoaders](04_Datasets_and_DataLoaders.ipynb) | Getting data in efficiently, which is usually the bottleneck |
| [Transforms](09_Transforms.ipynb) | Preprocessing and augmentation |
| [Save and Load](08_Save_and_Load.ipynb) | Checkpointing, and the distinction between weights and whole models |
| [timm](06_Timm_Models_Torch.ipynb) | Loading pretrained vision models from the library that collects them |
| [Transfer Learning](12_Transfer_Learning_resnet18.ipynb) | Adapting a pretrained ResNet-18 rather than starting from noise |

| [Model Diagrams](11_Model_Diagrams.ipynb) | Rendering an architecture as a picture |

## RAG

The most systematic part of this site: nineteen pages walking the retrieval-augmented generation pipeline stage by stage, then the concerns that sit across all of it. The retrieval and re-ranking pages restrict themselves to open-source components.

**The pipeline, in order**

| Page | Covers |
|---|---|
| [RAG](LLM/RAG/01_RAG.ipynb) | The overview, and what the rest of the folder expands |
| [Document Pre-processing](LLM/RAG/15_Document_preprocessing.ipynb) | Getting source material into a usable state |
| [Chunking](LLM/RAG/02_Chunking.ipynb) | Splitting documents, which sets the ceiling on everything downstream |
| [Embedding](LLM/RAG/03_Embedding.ipynb) | Turning chunks into vectors |
| [Indexing](LLM/RAG/04_Indexing.ipynb) | Storing them so they can be searched |
| [Query Transformation](LLM/RAG/07_Query_transformation.ipynb) | Rewriting the question before searching with it |
| [Retrieval](LLM/RAG/05_Retrieval.ipynb) | Dense, sparse, and hybrid search |
| [Re-ranking](LLM/RAG/06_Re-ranking.ipynb) | Reordering candidates before they reach the model |
| [Context Assembly](LLM/RAG/08_Context_assembly.ipynb) | Deciding what actually goes in the prompt |
| [Generation](LLM/RAG/09_Generation.ipynb) | The answer, and grounding it in what was retrieved |

**Across the pipeline**

| Page | Covers |
|---|---|
| [Evaluation](LLM/RAG/10_Evaluation.ipynb) | Scoring a pipeline you cannot otherwise improve |
| [Observability](LLM/RAG/11_Observability.ipynb) | Seeing what it did in production |
| [Caching](LLM/RAG/14_Caching.ipynb) | Cutting cost and latency |
| [Index Lifecycle](LLM/RAG/12_Index_lifecycle.ipynb) | Keeping the index current as documents change |
| [Access Control](LLM/RAG/13_Access_control.ipynb) | Making sure retrieval respects who is asking |
| [Guardrails](LLM/RAG/17_Guardrails.ipynb) | Constraining what comes out |

**Variants**

| Page | Covers |
|---|---|
| [Agentic RAG](LLM/RAG/16_Agentic_RAG.ipynb) | Letting the model decide when and what to retrieve |
| [Graph RAG](LLM/RAG/18_Graph_RAG.ipynb) | Retrieval over a knowledge graph instead of a flat index |
| [Multimodal RAG](LLM/RAG/19_Multimodal_RAG.ipynb) | Retrieval across images and documents, not only text |

---

## Not Covered Yet

- **No fine-tuning.** Nothing on LoRA, QLoRA, adapters, or full fine-tuning, which is the most obvious gap given the depth of everything around it.
- **Nothing on training at scale**: no distributed training, mixed precision as a subject, or gradient accumulation.
- **No diffusion model page**, despite GANs and autoencoders both being covered and diffusion having displaced them for generation.
- **No serving or inference optimisation.** Quantisation, batching, and throughput are absent.
- **[Indexing](LLM/RAG/04_Indexing.ipynb) opens with a `models.py` heading**, which suggests it was drafted from a specific project rather than written as a reference page.
- **[Car Detection](Car_detection/00_car_detection.ipynb) is thin** at six cells, and sits alone in its own folder.
- The vision pages here overlap the task pages in [DL Tasks](https://bthek1.github.io/DL_tasks/); this site is the how, that one is the which, but the boundary is not always obvious.

---
